verdict.rationale: An email client SaaS could plausibly offer a public API with UI parity, so this story applies to Shortwave. The evidence pack documents no public Shortwave API at all, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all return 404. The MCP and Zapier integrations let Shortwave's own AI assistant reach out to other apps; they do not expose Shortwave's UI functions programmatically, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.
